caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental urn with a lid, positioned atop a square pedestal. The urn is beige with a smooth surface, decorated with a pattern of red and green flowers and leaves encircling its midsection. It has a domed lid, shaded in a gradient from beige at the base to a deeper grayish hue towards the knob at the top, and the knob itself is shaped like a small sphere with a pointed tip. The pedestal is square-shaped, predominantly beige, and features a border of yellow and green circular decorations along the edges. Each side of the pedestal displays a different floral motif composed of green stems and leaves, with flowers in yellow, blue, and green. The entire composition is outlined with a plain, thin black border, with the artist’s name and the year 1936 written at the bottom right of the image. The background is a light, unadorned beige.
title: Wooden Mantel Ornament
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
